percentiles: Nearest rank, no interpolation. Failed attempts remain counted; failed milestones have null latency. n10 p95 is the maximum and is not a production p95 guarantee.
metricNotes: Never pool historical Mac, interrupted Mac, separate CI profiles or distinct CI attempts.
Raw rows include source preparation, click content/interactive milestones, complete journey and network completion where observed. Missing quantities remain null.
Encoded bytes remain null when any contributing response size is unknown; known partial bytes and unknown counts are separate.
Browser aborted counters represent requestfailed events; workflow transport causes are not subdivided. Native aborted/pending classifications are unavailable separately from failed transport rows.
Server-Timing spans may overlap; their durations must not be added as mutually exclusive stages. Pure pool acquisition/locks and detailed Auth transport are unavailable.

OBSERVER_QA.json independently reproduces missed text-only readiness in the measured strict-review observer. Its recorded journey durations remain unchanged and may include observation delay; no particular past tail is proved to have that cause. Future release clearance requires corrected-observer comparison. The independent primary directory gate is unchanged.

The strict full-review readiness observer inspects visible rows; observer/actionability/automation costs are part of these instrumented journey durations and can scale with DOM size. They are not isolated app execution or production-user timings.
Complete-review timing follows the current Voting history console. Persistent live rooms are covered functionally, not timed.

Filtering, sorting, pagination, revocation, rapid navigation and drafts have canonical/browser functional checks; separate controlled latency distributions for all of those operations are not available.
